title: Police Response to Street Gang Violence in California:  Improving the Investigative Process, 1985
description:
This data collection examines gang and non-gang homicides as 
 well as other types of offenses in small California jurisdictions. Data 
 are provided on violent gang offenses and offenders as well as on a 
 companion sample of non-gang offenses and offenders. Two separate data 
 files are supplied, one for participants and one for incidents. The 
 participant data include age, gender, race, and role of participants. 
 The incident data include information from the "violent incident data 
 collection form" (setting, auto involvement, and amount of property 
 loss), and the "group indicators coding form" (argot, tattoos, 
clothing, and slang terminology).
